cards.back:
A word used to show a different or opposite idea.
Bahasa Indonesia: namun
Example: The shop was closed. However, the market was still open.
cards.say: however. A word used to show a different or opposite idea. The shop was closed. However, the market was still open.

cards.back:
A word that shows a result of what you said before.
Bahasa Indonesia: oleh karena itu
Example: It rained all day. Therefore, we stayed indoors.
cards.say: therefore. A word that shows a result of what you said before. It rained all day. Therefore, we stayed indoors.

cards.back:
During the same time, in another place or way.
Bahasa Indonesia: sementara itu
Example: Mum cooked dinner. Meanwhile, I laid the table and poured the water.
cards.say: meanwhile. During the same time, in another place or way. Mum cooked dinner. Meanwhile, I laid the table and poured the water.

cards.back:
In spite of the fact that.
Bahasa Indonesia: meskipun
Example: Although he was tired, he finished his homework.
cards.say: although. In spite of the fact that. Although he was tired, he finished his homework.

cards.back:
For the reason that.
Bahasa Indonesia: karena
Example: We stayed inside because the thunder was very loud.
cards.say: because. For the reason that. We stayed inside because the thunder was very loud.

cards.back:
A word used to add another point.
Bahasa Indonesia: terlebih lagi
Example: The park is clean. Furthermore, it has a new playground.
cards.say: furthermore. A word used to add another point. The park is clean. Furthermore, it has a new playground.

cards.back:
If not, or in a different way.
Bahasa Indonesia: kalau tidak
Example: Hurry up, otherwise we will miss the first bus.
cards.say: otherwise. If not, or in a different way. Hurry up, otherwise we will miss the first bus.

cards.back:
Except if.
Bahasa Indonesia: kecuali jika
Example: We will play outside unless it starts to rain.
cards.say: unless. Except if. We will play outside unless it starts to rain.

cards.back:
A word used to compare two things that are different.
Bahasa Indonesia: sedangkan
Example: Rice needs a lot of water, whereas cactus plants need very little.
cards.say: whereas. A word used to compare two things that are different. Rice needs a lot of water, whereas cactus plants need very little.

cards.back:
At last, after a long time.
Bahasa Indonesia: akhirnya
Example: After many tries, she eventually learned to ride a bike.
cards.say: eventually. At last, after a long time. After many tries, she eventually learned to ride a bike.

cards.back:
At a later time.
Bahasa Indonesia: sesudah itu
Example: We had lunch and afterwards we went for a swim.
cards.say: afterwards. At a later time. We had lunch and afterwards we went for a swim.

cards.back:
Used to introduce the first point or step.
Bahasa Indonesia: pertama-tama
Example: Firstly, we must read the whole question very carefully.
cards.say: firstly. Used to introduce the first point or step. Firstly, we must read the whole question very carefully.

cards.back:
Used for the last point or step.
Bahasa Indonesia: akhirnya, terakhir
Example: Finally, wash your hands and dry them well.
cards.say: finally. Used for the last point or step. Finally, wash your hands and dry them well.

cards.back:
Used to add more information.
Bahasa Indonesia: selain itu
Example: In addition to books, the library lends films and games.
cards.say: in addition. Used to add more information. In addition to books, the library lends films and games.

cards.back:
Used to show something happened because of another thing.
Bahasa Indonesia: akibatnya
Example: It rained all night. As a result, the roads were flooded.
cards.say: as a result. Used to show something happened because of another thing. It rained all night. As a result, the roads were flooded.

cards.back:
Used to show a different point of view.
Bahasa Indonesia: di sisi lain
Example: Cycling is cheap. On the other hand, it can be slow.
cards.say: on the other hand. Used to show a different point of view. Cycling is cheap. On the other hand, it can be slow.

cards.back:
Used to introduce an example.
Bahasa Indonesia: misalnya
Example: Many fruits grow here, for example mangoes and bananas.
cards.say: for example. Used to introduce an example. Many fruits grow here, for example mangoes and bananas.

cards.back:
Used to begin the final summary.
Bahasa Indonesia: kesimpulannya
Example: In conclusion, recycling is a simple way to help the planet.
cards.say: in conclusion. Used to begin the final summary. In conclusion, recycling is a simple way to help the planet.

cards.back:
In spite of what has just been said.
Bahasa Indonesia: meskipun demikian
Example: The path was steep. Nevertheless, we reached the top before noon.
cards.say: nevertheless. In spite of what has just been said. The path was steep. Nevertheless, we reached the top before noon.

cards.back:
Also, used to add a further reason.
Bahasa Indonesia: lagi pula
Example: I am too tired to go out. Besides, it is raining.
cards.say: besides. Also, used to add a further reason. I am too tired to go out. Besides, it is raining.

cards.back:
From a time in the past until now, or because.
Bahasa Indonesia: sejak, karena
Example: We have lived in this town since I was born.
cards.say: since. From a time in the past until now, or because. We have lived in this town since I was born.

cards.back:
Up to the time that.
Bahasa Indonesia: sampai
Example: Wait here until the bell rings for the end of break.
cards.say: until. Up to the time that. Wait here until the bell rings for the end of break.
